Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the DHFWO Chikkaballapur Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your online application for the DHFWO Chikkaballapur Recruitment 2026 is 03 September 2026. Ensure all details are accurate before the deadline.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in this recruitment?
faq.answer: A total of 45 vacancies are available for the posts of Junior Laboratory Technical Officer, Pharmacy Officer, and Nursing Officer in the District Health and Family Welfare Office Chikkaballapur.

faq.question: Q3. What is the maximum age limit for the applicants?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for all the posts in this recruitment is 45 years. Age relaxation will be provided as per government norms.

faq.question: Q4. What are the educational qualifications required for the posts?
faq.answer: The required qualifications include DMLT for Junior Laboratory Technical Officer, D.Pharm with Karnataka Pharmacy Council registration for Pharmacy Officer, and a Nursing qualification with Karnataka Nursing Council registration for Nursing Officer.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, as per the provided information, there is no application fee for any category of candidates applying for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q6. What is the mode of application for DHFWO Chikkaballapur Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application process for the DHFWO Chikkaballapur Recruitment 2026 is entirely online. Candidates need to apply through the official website or the provided link.

faq.question: Q7. What is the job type for these positions?
faq.answer: The positions offered under this recruitment are on a contractual basis. This means the employment will be for a fixed period as per the terms of the contract.

faq.question: Q8. When will the document verification take place?
faq.answer: Document verification for Junior Laboratory Technical Officer and Pharmacy Officer is scheduled for 04 September 2026, while for Nursing Officer, it will be on 05 September 2026.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I find the official notification PDF?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF can be accessed through the 'Important Links' section of this article. It contains all the detailed information about the recruitment.

faq.question: Q10. What is the selection process for these posts?
faq.answer: The selection process involves an online application, followed by document verification, and finally, the preparation of a merit list based on the candidates' qualifications and performance.
